title: Member Accounts Note: Kestrel Care Rewards Share of the Recent-Fees Credit on an Annual Pass Switch (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The recent-fees credit of a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services is a share of the order fees charged on the plan in the month up to the switch date less the refunds booked on the plan in that month, that net amount never below zero, and the credit is rounded to the cent. Its share depends on the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status together with the deliveries completed on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date.

## Share

| Active Kestrel Care Rewards level | Deliveries completed on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date | Share credited |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold or Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 6 or more | 100 percent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member or Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 6 or more | 75 percent |
| any level | 5 or fewer | 50 percent |
| no active membership, or any other membership | any number | 50 percent |

## Hypothetical cases (net recent fees $15.96)

| Level | Deliveries in 3 months | Share | Recent-fees credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 6 | 100 percent | $15.96 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 9 | 75 percent | $11.97 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 5 | 50 percent | $7.98 |
| none | 12 | 50 percent | $7.98 |

The deliveries counted are the orders recorded as delivered on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date.
